fields.label: PDC Transition Key
fields.description: Unique transition idempotency key: ChequeName|Receivable|FromState|ToState (canonical labels, normalized states). Legacy rows may use Direction|From|To only. At most one JE per key per PDC; purpose/posting_date/amount/journal_entry record what was posted.
